  let mut components : Std.HashMap String (String × String × String × String × String) := {}
  for line in (if componentPayload.isEmpty then [] else componentPayload.splitOn "\n") do
    match line.splitOn "\t" with
    | [n, nk, hk, i, m, a] =>
      if (components[n]?).isSome then throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: duplicate component request"
      components := components.insert n (nk, hk, i, m, a)
    | _ => throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: malformed component request"
  unless components.size == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: component count differs"
  let env ← Lean.getEnv
  let mut resolved : Array Lean.Name := #[]
  let mut catalog : Std.HashMap String (Array Lean.Name) := {}
  let mut verified : Nat := 0
  let mut active : Nat := 0
  let mut already : Nat := 0
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | continue
    unless (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]! do continue
    let ns := (catalog[n.toString]?).getD #[]
    catalog := catalog.insert n.toString (ns.push n)
  for (spelling, expectedHome) in requests do
    let ns := (catalog[spelling]?).getD #[]
    unless ns.size == 1 do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: absent/ambiguous imported name {spelling}; candidates={ns.size}"
    let n := ns[0]!
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no home for {spelling}"
    let home := env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]!
    unless home.toString == expectedHome do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: home differs for {spelling}: {home}"
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no constant for {spelling}"
    unless ci.isDefinition do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: requested nondefinition {spelling}"
    let some (nk, hk, ei, em, ea) := components[spelling]?
      | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: missing component request"
    unless nameKey n == nk && nameKey home == hk do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: actual Name components differ"
    let instanceFlag := Lean.Meta.isInstanceCore env n
    let matcherFlag := (Lean.Meta.Match.Extension.getMatcherInfo? env n).isSome
    let abbrevFlag := match ci with
      | .defnInfo d => match d.hints with | .abbrev => true | _ => false
      | _ => false
    unless toString instanceFlag == ei && toString matcherFlag == em && toString abbrevFlag == ea do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: definition/instance metadata differs"
    Lean.logInfo m!"G06-COMPONENT label={label} phase=install spelling={spelling} key={nk} home_key={hk} instance={instanceFlag}"
    let before ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM <| Lean.getReducibilityStatus n
    if before == .irreducible then
      already := already + 1
    else
      let id := Lean.mkIdent n
      Lean.Elab.Command.elabCommand (← `(command| attribute [local irreducible] $id:ident))
      active := active + 1
    let installed ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM <| Lean.getReducibilityStatus n
    unless installed == .irreducible do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: seal not installed for {spelling}"
    resolved := resolved.push n
    verified := verified + 1
    Lean.logInfo m!"G06-NAME label={label} spelling={spelling} actual={n.toString} home={home} before={repr before} installed={repr installed}"
  unless active + already == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: installation count mismatch"
  unless verified == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: verification count mismatch"
  let maskExt := Lean.Meta.globalInstanceExtension
  let maskEnv ← Lean.getEnv
  let scopes := maskExt.ext.getState maskEnv
  unless scopes.stateStack.length == 1 do
    throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: unfolding mask requires base scope"
  let mut scopedNames : Std.HashSet Lean.Name := {}
  for (_, payloads) in scopes.scopedEntries.map.toList do
    for n in payloads do
      scopedNames := scopedNames.insert n
  let mut removed : Nat := 0
  for n in resolved do
    if scopedNames.contains n then
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: scoped unfolding payload intersects request {n}"
    if Lean.Meta.isGlobalInstance maskEnv n then
      removed := removed + 1
  -- InstanceEntry's BEq checks only val, so compare every field explicitly.
  let entryFields (e : Lean.Meta.InstanceEntry) :=
    (e.keys, Lean.ExprStructEq.mk e.val, e.priority, e.globalName?, e.synthOrder, e.attrKind)
  let lookupSnapshot (e : Lean.Environment) :=
    let s := Lean.Meta.instanceExtension.getState e
    (s.discrTree.toArray.map (fun (ks, entry) => (ks, entryFields entry)),
      s.instanceNames.toArray.map (fun (n, entry) => (n, entryFields entry)), s.erased.toList)
  let beforeLookup := lookupSnapshot env
  Lean.modifyEnv fun current =>
    maskExt.modifyState current fun membership =>
      resolved.foldl (fun s n => s.erase n) membership
  let maskedEnv ← Lean.getEnv
  unless beforeLookup == lookupSnapshot maskedEnv do
    throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: typeclass lookup state changed"
  for n in resolved do
    if Lean.Meta.isGlobalInstance maskedEnv n then
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: unfolding membership after mask for {n}"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-MASK label={label} phase=install requested={requests.size} verified={resolved.size} removed={removed} scope_depth=1 scoped_names={scopedNames.size} tc_state=preserved"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-SEAL label={label} requested={requests.size} active={active} already_irreducible={already} verified={verified}"

  let mut components : Std.HashMap String (String × String × String × String × String) := {}
  for line in (if componentPayload.isEmpty then [] else componentPayload.splitOn "\n") do
    match line.splitOn "\t" with
    | [n, nk, hk, i, m, a] =>
      if (components[n]?).isSome then throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: duplicate component request"
      components := components.insert n (nk, hk, i, m, a)
    | _ => throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: malformed component request"
  unless components.size == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: component count differs"
  let env ← Lean.getEnv
  let mut resolved : Array Lean.Name := #[]
  let mut catalog : Std.HashMap String (Array Lean.Name) := {}
  let mut verified : Nat := 0
  let mut active : Nat := 0
  let mut already : Nat := 0
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | continue
    unless (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]! do continue
    let ns := (catalog[n.toString]?).getD #[]
    catalog := catalog.insert n.toString (ns.push n)
  for (spelling, expectedHome) in requests do
    let ns := (catalog[spelling]?).getD #[]
    unless ns.size == 1 do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: absent/ambiguous imported name {spelling}; candidates={ns.size}"
    let n := ns[0]!
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no home for {spelling}"
    let home := env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]!
    unless home.toString == expectedHome do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: home differs for {spelling}: {home}"
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no constant for {spelling}"
    unless ci.isDefinition do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: requested nondefinition {spelling}"
    let some (nk, hk, ei, em, ea) := components[spelling]?
      | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: missing component request"
    unless nameKey n == nk && nameKey home == hk do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: actual Name components differ"
    let instanceFlag := Lean.Meta.isInstanceCore env n
    let matcherFlag := (Lean.Meta.Match.Extension.getMatcherInfo? env n).isSome
    let abbrevFlag := match ci with
      | .defnInfo d => match d.hints with | .abbrev => true | _ => false
      | _ => false
    unless toString instanceFlag == ei && toString matcherFlag == em && toString abbrevFlag == ea do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: definition/instance metadata differs"
    Lean.logInfo m!"G06-COMPONENT label={label} phase=install spelling={spelling} key={nk} home_key={hk} instance={instanceFlag}"
    let before ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM <| Lean.getReducibilityStatus n
    if before == .irreducible then
      already := already + 1
    else
      let id := Lean.mkIdent n
      Lean.Elab.Command.elabCommand (← `(command| attribute [local irreducible] $id:ident))
      active := active + 1
    let installed ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM <| Lean.getReducibilityStatus n
    unless installed == .irreducible do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: seal not installed for {spelling}"
    resolved := resolved.push n
    verified := verified + 1
    Lean.logInfo m!"G06-NAME label={label} spelling={spelling} actual={n.toString} home={home} before={repr before} installed={repr installed}"
  unless active + already == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: installation count mismatch"
  unless verified == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: verification count mismatch"
  let maskExt := Lean.Meta.globalInstanceExtension
  let maskEnv ← Lean.getEnv
  let scopes := maskExt.ext.getState maskEnv
  unless scopes.stateStack.length == 1 do
    throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: unfolding mask requires base scope"
  let mut scopedNames : Std.HashSet Lean.Name := {}
  for (_, payloads) in scopes.scopedEntries.map.toList do
    for n in payloads do
      scopedNames := scopedNames.insert n
  let mut removed : Nat := 0
  for n in resolved do
    if scopedNames.contains n then
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: scoped unfolding payload intersects request {n}"
    if Lean.Meta.isGlobalInstance maskEnv n then
      removed := removed + 1
  -- InstanceEntry's BEq checks only val, so compare every field explicitly.
  let entryFields (e : Lean.Meta.InstanceEntry) :=
    (e.keys, Lean.ExprStructEq.mk e.val, e.priority, e.globalName?, e.synthOrder, e.attrKind)
  let lookupSnapshot (e : Lean.Environment) :=
    let s := Lean.Meta.instanceExtension.getState e
    (s.discrTree.toArray.map (fun (ks, entry) => (ks, entryFields entry)),
      s.instanceNames.toArray.map (fun (n, entry) => (n, entryFields entry)), s.erased.toList)
  let beforeLookup := lookupSnapshot env
  Lean.modifyEnv fun current =>
    maskExt.modifyState current fun membership =>
      resolved.foldl (fun s n => s.erase n) membership
  let maskedEnv ← Lean.getEnv
  unless beforeLookup == lookupSnapshot maskedEnv do
    throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: typeclass lookup state changed"
  for n in resolved do
    if Lean.Meta.isGlobalInstance maskedEnv n then
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: unfolding membership after mask for {n}"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-MASK label={label} phase=install requested={requests.size} verified={resolved.size} removed={removed} scope_depth=1 scoped_names={scopedNames.size} tc_state=preserved"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-SEAL label={label} requested={requests.size} active={active} already_irreducible={already} verified={verified}"

[\"str\",\"TCSlib\"],[\"str\",\"Cryptography\"],[\"str\",\"Pseudorandom\"],[\"str\",\"Functions\"],[\"str\",\"LazySampling\"]]\tfalse\tfalse\tfalse\n_private.TCSlib.Cryptography.Pseudorandom.Functions.LazySampling.0.TCSlib.Cryptography.QueryTree.mergeTable\t[[\"str\",\"_private\"],[\"str\",\"TCSlib\"],[\"str\",\"Cryptography\"],[\"str\",\"Pseudorandom\"],[\"str\",\"Functions\"],[\"str\",\"LazySampling\"],[\"num\",\"0\"],[\"str\",\"TCSlib\"],[\"str\",\"Cryptography\"],[\"str\",\"QueryTree\"],[\"str\",\"mergeTable\"]]\t[[\"str\",\"TCSlib\"],[\"str\",\"Cryptography\"],[\"str\",\"Pseudorandom\"],[\"str\",\"Functions\"],[\"str\",\"LazySampling\"]]\tfalse\tfalse\tfalse"
  let mut components : Std.HashMap String (String × String × String × String × String) := {}
  for line in (if componentPayload.isEmpty then [] else componentPayload.splitOn "\n") do
    match line.splitOn "\t" with
    | [n, nk, hk, i, m, a] =>
      if (components[n]?).isSome then throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: duplicate component request"
      components := components.insert n (nk, hk, i, m, a)
    | _ => throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: malformed component request"
  unless components.size == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: component count differs"
  let env ← Lean.getEnv
  let mut resolved : Array Lean.Name := #[]
  let mut catalog : Std.HashMap String (Array Lean.Name) := {}
  let mut verified : Nat := 0
  let mut active : Nat := 0
  let mut already : Nat := 0
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | continue
    unless (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]! do continue
    let ns := (catalog[n.toString]?).getD #[]
    catalog := catalog.insert n.toString (ns.push n)
  for (spelling, expectedHome) in requests do
    let ns := (catalog[spelling]?).getD #[]
    unless ns.size == 1 do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: absent/ambiguous imported name {spelling}; candidates={ns.size}"
    let n := ns[0]!
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no home for {spelling}"
    let home := env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]!
    unless home.toString == expectedHome do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: home differs for {spelling}: {home}"
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no constant for {spelling}"
    unless ci.isDefinition do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: requested nondefinition {spelling}"
    let some (nk, hk, ei, em, ea) := components[spelling]?
      | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: missing component request"
    unless nameKey n == nk && nameKey home == hk do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: actual Name components differ"
    let instanceFlag := Lean.Meta.isInstanceCore env n
    let matcherFlag := (Lean.Meta.Match.Extension.getMatcherInfo? env n).isSome
    let abbrevFlag := match ci with
      | .defnInfo d => match d.hints with | .abbrev => true | _ => false
      | _ => false
    unless toString instanceFlag == ei && toString matcherFlag == em && toString abbrevFlag == ea do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: definition/instance metadata differs"
    Lean.logInfo m!"G06-COMPONENT label={label} phase=install spelling={spelling} key={nk} home_key={hk} instance={instanceFlag}"
    let before ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM <| Lean.getReducibilityStatus n
    if before == .irreducible then
      already := already + 1
    else
      let id := Lean.mkIdent n
      Lean.Elab.Command.elabCommand (← `(command| attribute [local irreducible] $id:ident))
      active := active + 1
    let installed ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM <| Lean.getReducibilityStatus n
    unless installed == .irreducible do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: seal not installed for {spelling}"
    resolved := resolved.push n
    verified := verified + 1
    Lean.logInfo m!"G06-NAME label={label} spelling={spelling} actual={n.toString} home={home} before={repr before} installed={repr installed}"
  unless active + already == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: installation count mismatch"
  unless verified == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: verification count mismatch"
  let maskExt := Lean.Meta.globalInstanceExtension
  let maskEnv ← Lean.getEnv
  let scopes := maskExt.ext.getState maskEnv
  unless scopes.stateStack.length == 1 do
    throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: unfolding mask requires base scope"
  let mut scopedNames : Std.HashSet Lean.Name := {}
  for (_, payloads) in scopes.scopedEntries.map.toList do
    for n in payloads do
      scopedNames := scopedNames.insert n
  let mut removed : Nat := 0
  for n in resolved do
    if scopedNames.contains n then
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: scoped unfolding payload intersects request {n}"
    if Lean.Meta.isGlobalInstance maskEnv n then
      removed := removed + 1
  -- InstanceEntry's BEq checks only val, so compare every field explicitly.
  let entryFields (e : Lean.Meta.InstanceEntry) :=
    (e.keys, Lean.ExprStructEq.mk e.val, e.priority, e.globalName?, e.synthOrder, e.attrKind)
  let lookupSnapshot (e : Lean.Environment) :=
    let s := Lean.Meta.instanceExtension.getState e
    (s.discrTree.toArray.map (fun (ks, entry) => (ks, entryFields entry)),
      s.instanceNames.toArray.map (fun (n, entry) => (n, entryFields entry)), s.erased.toList)
  let beforeLookup := lookupSnapshot env
  Lean.modifyEnv fun current =>
    maskExt.modifyState current fun membership =>
      resolved.foldl (fun s n => s.erase n) membership
  let maskedEnv ← Lean.getEnv
  unless beforeLookup == lookupSnapshot maskedEnv do
    throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: typeclass lookup state changed"
  for n in resolved do
    if Lean.Meta.isGlobalInstance maskedEnv n then
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: unfolding membership after mask for {n}"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-MASK label={label} phase=install requested={requests.size} verified={resolved.size} removed={removed} scope_depth=1 scoped_names={scopedNames.size} tc_state=preserved"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-SEAL label={label} requested={requests.size} active={active} already_irreducible={already} verified={verified}"


set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# A common transcript for the hash-and-sign reductions

Fix the signature keys, hash index, adversary tape and signing tape. The resulting
transcript is shared by the collision-finding and signature-forging reductions of
[PS10, Theorem 144.1]. Because the adversary makes at most one query, sampling signing
coins per query has the same law as drawing the signing tape before this transcript.

## Main definitions

* `HashSignFill.hashedReply`: the original signer applied to the hashed message.
* `HashSignFill.fixedSign`, `sampledHashSign`: the fixed-tape and fresh-tape signing oracles.
* `HashSignFill.transcript`: the adversary's output and full signing-query log.
* `HashSignFill.Success`: acceptance and message freshness in a common transcript.

## Main results

* The defining equations and application readers expose each computation.
* `HashSignFill.expect_sampledHashSign_eq_transcript`: signing randomness may be sampled
  before the common transcript.

## References

* [PS10] R. Pass, a. shelat, *A Course in Cryptography*, lecture notes, 3rd ed., January 2010,
  Theorem 144.1, book pp. 144–145.
-/

namespace TCSlib.Cryptography.Authentication.HashSignFill

open Complexity Turing TCSlib.Cryptography TCSlib.Cryptography.Games

/-- With signing tape `rs` fixed, hash `m` and run the original signer under `sk`, padding
the signature to the declared signature width [PS10, Theorem 144.1]. -/
def hashedReply (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk i : List Bool)
    (rs : S.sign.Coins n) (m : Fin (H.domLen.eval n) → Bool) :
    Fin (S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool :=
  padFin (S.sigLen.eval n) (S.sign.runAt n
    (pairEncode sk (HashSignForward.hashWord H S (List.replicate n true) i (List.ofFn m))) rs)

/-- The fixed-tape hashed reply is the padded original signer output on `⟨sk, h_i(m)⟩`. -/
theorem hashedReply_eq (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk i : List Bool)
    (rs : S.sign.Coins n) (m : Fin (H.domLen.eval n) → Bool) :
    hashedReply H S n sk i rs m =
      padFin (S.sigLen.eval n) (S.sign.runAt n
        (pairEncode sk (HashSignForward.hashWord H S (List.replicate n true) i (List.ofFn m)))
        rs) := rfl

/-- The fixed-tape signing oracle answers every query using `hashedReply` and has trivial
state [PS10, Theorem 144.1]. -/
def fixedSign (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk i : List Bool)
    (rs : S.sign.Coins n) :
    QueryImpl (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n))
      Unit unifSpec :=
  fun _ m _ => .pure (hashedReply H S n sk i rs m, ())

/-- The fixed-tape oracle is the pure answer function `m ↦ (hashedReply m, ())`. -/
theorem fixedSign_eq (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk i : List Bool)
    (rs : S.sign.Coins n) :
    fixedSign H S n sk i rs = fun _ m _ => .pure (hashedReply H S n sk i rs m, ()) := rfl

/-- Applying the fixed-tape oracle returns the hashed signature and trivial state. -/
theorem fixedSign_apply (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk i : List Bool)
    (rs : S.sign.Coins n) (j : Fin 1) (m : Fin (H.domLen.eval n) → Bool) (s : Unit) :
    fixedSign H S n sk i rs j m s = .pure (hashedReply H S n sk i rs m, ()) := rfl

/-- The common transcript runs `A` on `⟨pk,i⟩` with one query allowed, fixed signing tape,
and a full query log [PS10, Theorem 144.1]. -/
def transcript (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (A : NUPPT) (n : ℕ)
    (pk sk i : List Bool) (rs : S.sign.Coins n) (rA : A.Coins n) :
    ProbComp ((Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) ×
      (Unit × QueryLog (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n)
        (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)))) :=
  simulate (fixedSign H S n sk i rs).withLog
    (A.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)
      (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n)) n 1 (pairEncode pk i) rA) ((), [])

/-- The common transcript is the logged simulation with the fixed-tape signing oracle. -/
theorem transcript_eq (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (A : NUPPT) (n : ℕ)
    (pk sk i : List Bool) (rs : S.sign.Coins n) (rA : A.Coins n) :
    transcript H S A n pk sk i rs rA =
      simulate (fixedSign H S n sk i rs).withLog
        (A.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)
          (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n)) n 1 (pairEncode pk i) rA) ((), []) := rfl

/-- The fresh-tape hash-and-sign oracle samples an original signing tape independently
for every query and keeps trivial state [PS10, Theorem 144.1]. -/
noncomputable def sampledHashSign (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk i : List Bool) :
    QueryImpl (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n))
      Unit unifSpec :=
  QueryImpl.ofComp fun _ m => (ProbComp.sample (S.sign.Coins n)).bind fun rs =>
    .pure (hashedReply H S n sk i rs m)

/-- The fresh-tape oracle is `ofComp` of the original signing-tape sample followed by
the corresponding fixed-tape hashed reply. -/
theorem sampledHashSign_eq (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk i : List Bool) :
    sampledHashSign H S n sk i =
      QueryImpl.ofComp (fun _ m => (ProbComp.sample (S.sign.Coins n)).bind fun rs =>
        .pure (hashedReply H S n sk i rs m)) := rfl

/-- Applying the fresh-tape oracle samples one signing tape, returns its hashed signature,
and preserves the trivial state. -/
theorem sampledHashSign_apply (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk i : List Bool)
    (j : Fin 1) (m : Fin (H.domLen.eval n) → Bool) (s : Unit) :
    sampledHashSign H S n sk i j m s =
      (ProbComp.sample (S.sign.Coins n)).bind fun rs =>
        .pure (hashedReply H S n sk i rs m, s) := by
  simp only [sampledHashSign_eq, QueryImpl.ofComp_apply,
    OracleComp.bind_assoc, OracleComp.pure_bind]

/-- The expected payoff of a fresh-tape hash-and-sign simulation equals the expectation
obtained by drawing one signing tape and running the common transcript, including its log.

**Proof sketch.** The machine computation has unit query cost at most one by its published
budget contract. `expect_simulate_sample_once` therefore moves the signing-tape sample
outside the logged simulation; the fixed-tape implementation is exactly `fixedSign`. -/
theorem expect_sampledHashSign_eq_transcript (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (A : NUPPT)
    (n : ℕ) (pk sk i : List Bool) (rA : A.Coins n)
    (g : (Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) ×
      (Unit × QueryLog (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n)
        (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n))) → ℝ) :
    ProbComp.expect
        (simulate (sampledHashSign H S n sk i).withLog
          (A.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)
            (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n)) n 1 (pairEncode pk i) rA) ((), [])) g =
      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (S.sign.Coins n)) (fun rs =>
        ProbComp.expect (transcript H S A n pk sk i rs rA) g) := by
  simpa only [sampledHashSign_eq, transcript_eq, fixedSign_eq] using
    expect_simulate_sample_once (fun (_ : Fin 1) m rs => hashedReply H S n sk i rs m)
      (A.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)
        (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n)) n 1 (pairEncode pk i) rA)
      (A.toCompOn_costBoundedBy _ n 1 (pairEncode pk i) rA) g

/-- The common transcript is a successful hash-and-sign forgery when the original verifier
accepts the hashed final message and that message did not occur in the inner query log
[PS10, Theorem 144.1]. -/
def Success (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk i : List Bool)
    (res : (Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) ×
      (Unit × QueryLog (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n)
        (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)))) : Prop :=
  S.Accepts n pk (padFin (S.msgLen.eval n)
      (H.eval (atParam n (pairEncode i (List.ofFn (splitBits res.1).1)))))
    (splitBits res.1).2 ∧
    ∀ e ∈ res.2.2, e.2.1 ≠ (splitBits res.1).1

/-- Success is original-scheme acceptance on the hash, together with freshness of the
unhashed final message in the common query log. -/
theorem success_iff (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk i : List Bool)
    (res : (Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) ×
      (Unit × QueryLog (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n)
        (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)))) :
    Success H S n pk i res ↔
      S.Accepts n pk (padFin (S.msgLen.eval n)
        (H.eval (atParam n (pairEncode i (List.ofFn (splitBits res.1).1)))))
        (splitBits res.1).2 ∧
      ∀ e ∈ res.2.2, e.2.1 ≠ (splitBits res.1).1 := Iff.rfl

end TCSlib.Cryptography.Authentication.HashSignFill

  let mut components : Std.HashMap String (String × String × String × String × String) := {}
  for line in (if componentPayload.isEmpty then [] else componentPayload.splitOn "\n") do
    match line.splitOn "\t" with
    | [n, nk, hk, i, m, a] =>
      if (components[n]?).isSome then throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: duplicate component request"
      components := components.insert n (nk, hk, i, m, a)
    | _ => throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: malformed component request"
  unless components.size == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: component count differs"
  let env ← Lean.getEnv
  let mut catalog : Std.HashMap String (Array Lean.Name) := {}
  let mut verified : Nat := 0
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | continue
    unless (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]! do continue
    let ns := (catalog[n.toString]?).getD #[]
    catalog := catalog.insert n.toString (ns.push n)
  for (spelling, expectedHome) in requests do
    let ns := (catalog[spelling]?).getD #[]
    unless ns.size == 1 do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: absent/ambiguous imported name {spelling}; candidates={ns.size}"
    let n := ns[0]!
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no home for {spelling}"
    let home := env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]!
    unless home.toString == expectedHome do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: home differs for {spelling}: {home}"
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no constant for {spelling}"
    unless ci.isDefinition do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: requested nondefinition {spelling}"
    let some (nk, hk, ei, em, ea) := components[spelling]?
      | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: missing component request"
    unless nameKey n == nk && nameKey home == hk do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: actual Name components differ"
    let instanceFlag := Lean.Meta.isInstanceCore env n
    let matcherFlag := (Lean.Meta.Match.Extension.getMatcherInfo? env n).isSome
    let abbrevFlag := match ci with
      | .defnInfo d => match d.hints with | .abbrev => true | _ => false
      | _ => false
    unless toString instanceFlag == ei && toString matcherFlag == em && toString abbrevFlag == ea do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: definition/instance metadata differs"
    Lean.logInfo m!"G06-COMPONENT label={label} phase=eof spelling={spelling} key={nk} home_key={hk} instance={instanceFlag}"
    let installed ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM <| Lean.getReducibilityStatus n
    unless installed == .irreducible do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: seal not installed at EOF for {spelling}"
    if Lean.Meta.isGlobalInstance env n then
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: unfolding membership at EOF for {spelling}"
    verified := verified + 1
  unless verified == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: verification count mismatch"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-MASK label={label} phase=eof requested={requests.size} verified={verified}"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-SEAL-END label={label} requested={requests.size} verified={verified}"

  let mut components : Std.HashMap String (String × String × String × String × String) := {}
  for line in (if componentPayload.isEmpty then [] else componentPayload.splitOn "\n") do
    match line.splitOn "\t" with
    | [n, nk, hk, i, m, a] =>
      if (components[n]?).isSome then throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: duplicate component request"
      components := components.insert n (nk, hk, i, m, a)
    | _ => throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: malformed component request"
  unless components.size == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: component count differs"
  let env ← Lean.getEnv
  let mut catalog : Std.HashMap String (Array Lean.Name) := {}
  let mut verified : Nat := 0
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | continue
    unless (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]! do continue
    let ns := (catalog[n.toString]?).getD #[]
    catalog := catalog.insert n.toString (ns.push n)
  for (spelling, expectedHome) in requests do
    let ns := (catalog[spelling]?).getD #[]
    unless ns.size == 1 do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: absent/ambiguous imported name {spelling}; candidates={ns.size}"
    let n := ns[0]!
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no home for {spelling}"
    let home := env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]!
    unless home.toString == expectedHome do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: home differs for {spelling}: {home}"
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no constant for {spelling}"
    unless ci.isDefinition do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: requested nondefinition {spelling}"
    let some (nk, hk, ei, em, ea) := components[spelling]?
      | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: missing component request"
    unless nameKey n == nk && nameKey home == hk do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: actual Name components differ"
    let instanceFlag := Lean.Meta.isInstanceCore env n
    let matcherFlag := (Lean.Meta.Match.Extension.getMatcherInfo? env n).isSome
    let abbrevFlag := match ci with
      | .defnInfo d => match d.hints with | .abbrev => true | _ => false
      | _ => false
    unless toString instanceFlag == ei && toString matcherFlag == em && toString abbrevFlag == ea do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: definition/instance metadata differs"
    Lean.logInfo m!"G06-COMPONENT label={label} phase=eof spelling={spelling} key={nk} home_key={hk} instance={instanceFlag}"
    let installed ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM <| Lean.getReducibilityStatus n
    unless installed == .irreducible do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: seal not installed at EOF for {spelling}"
    if Lean.Meta.isGlobalInstance env n then
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: unfolding membership at EOF for {spelling}"
    verified := verified + 1
  unless verified == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: verification count mismatch"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-MASK label={label} phase=eof requested={requests.size} verified={verified}"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-SEAL-END label={label} requested={requests.size} verified={verified}"

  let mut components : Std.HashMap String (String × String × String × String × String) := {}
  for line in (if componentPayload.isEmpty then [] else componentPayload.splitOn "\n") do
    match line.splitOn "\t" with
    | [n, nk, hk, i, m, a] =>
      if (components[n]?).isSome then throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: duplicate component request"
      components := components.insert n (nk, hk, i, m, a)
    | _ => throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: malformed component request"
  unless components.size == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: component count differs"
  let env ← Lean.getEnv
  let mut catalog : Std.HashMap String (Array Lean.Name) := {}
  let mut verified : Nat := 0
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | continue
    unless (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]! do continue
    let ns := (catalog[n.toString]?).getD #[]
    catalog := catalog.insert n.toString (ns.push n)
  for (spelling, expectedHome) in requests do
    let ns := (catalog[spelling]?).getD #[]
    unless ns.size == 1 do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: absent/ambiguous imported name {spelling}; candidates={ns.size}"
    let n := ns[0]!
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no home for {spelling}"
    let home := env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]!
    unless home.toString == expectedHome do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: home differs for {spelling}: {home}"
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: no constant for {spelling}"
    unless ci.isDefinition do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: requested nondefinition {spelling}"
    let some (nk, hk, ei, em, ea) := components[spelling]?
      | throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: missing component request"
    unless nameKey n == nk && nameKey home == hk do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: actual Name components differ"
    let instanceFlag := Lean.Meta.isInstanceCore env n
    let matcherFlag := (Lean.Meta.Match.Extension.getMatcherInfo? env n).isSome
    let abbrevFlag := match ci with
      | .defnInfo d => match d.hints with | .abbrev => true | _ => false
      | _ => false
    unless toString instanceFlag == ei && toString matcherFlag == em && toString abbrevFlag == ea do
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: definition/instance metadata differs"
    Lean.logInfo m!"G06-COMPONENT label={label} phase=eof spelling={spelling} key={nk} home_key={hk} instance={instanceFlag}"
    let installed ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM <| Lean.getReducibilityStatus n
    unless installed == .irreducible do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: seal not installed at EOF for {spelling}"
    if Lean.Meta.isGlobalInstance env n then
      throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: unfolding membership at EOF for {spelling}"
    verified := verified + 1
  unless verified == requests.size do throwError "G06-HARNESS {label}: verification count mismatch"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-MASK label={label} phase=eof requested={requests.size} verified={verified}"
  Lean.logInfo m!"G06-SEAL-END label={label} requested={requests.size} verified={verified}"
